name: Pipelined DML cross-generation owner retargeting
module: TiDB pipelined DML + client-go generation flush

payload.p_check: the same primary, unique-index, generated-index, prefix-index, or multi-valued-index owner is rewritten across many forced flush generations
payload.q_claim: the final row and every index encode the same winning owner as standard DML
payload.green: standard and BULK rowsets plus forced-index scans match and ADMIN CHECK is green
payload.negative_screen: pipelined mutation compiler omits the untouched-index filter, but ordinary non-index UPDATE does not emit unchanged index KVs into the mem buffer

green_cells: REPLACE retargets primary, two unique, and generated-index owners
ON DUPLICATE migrates the primary owner
common handle with collation, prefix index, and nullable unique owner

evidence.interpretation: unchanged unique/secondary index KVs were not emitted, so the compiler filter omission was unreachable for this shape
